name: SLG
recent: SLGC Berhad 于2026年10月6日在ACE Market上市，IPO发行价为RM0.28，筹集RM29.4百万。上市后不久，公司于10月29日获得一份价值RM50.2百万的EPC合约，用于雪兰莪工业工厂开发。近期董事和主要股东申报了股权变动。
notable: 公司于2026年10月6日在ACE Market上市，IPO发行价为RM0.28，涉及公开发行105,000,000股新股及献售63,000,000股现有股份。
公司获得一份价值RM50.2百万的EPC合约，用于雪兰莪工业工厂开发，这是上市后的首个合约。
risks: 董事和主要股东在上市后不久申报了股权变动，包括首席财务官以IPO粉表配额认购股份。

recent_en: SLGC Berhad listed on the ACE Market on 6 October 2026 at an IPO price of RM0.28, raising RM29.4 million. Shortly after listing, the company secured a RM50.2 million EPC contract on 29 October for an industrial factory development in Selangor. Directors and a substantial shareholder have recently reported changes in their interests.
notable_en: The company listed on the ACE Market on 6 October 2026 at an IPO price of RM0.28, involving a public issue of 105,000,000 new shares and an offer for sale of 63,000,000 existing shares.
The company secured a RM50.2 million EPC contract for an industrial factory development in Selangor, its first contract after listing.
risks_en: Directors and a substantial shareholder reported changes in their interests shortly after listing, including the Chief Financial Officer subscribing for shares under the IPO pink form allocation.
